name: Kathmandu
title: Kathmandu: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Kathmandu, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: Kathmandu is cooler than the lowland cities on this site, but it set a temperature record in 2024 and its core runs several degrees hotter than the valley around it. The sources reviewed show research and calls for action rather than a city heat programme: no heat action plan was found for the city, and the most concrete public works are greening and a pavement trial next door in Lalitpur.

orgs.name: People's Courage International
orgs.summary: Co-published a survey of 305 migrant workers in Kathmandu on heat and hard work.

orgs.name: World Bank
orgs.summary: Its 2026 report on heat in South Asia's cities measured Kathmandu's urban heat and recommended heritage site retrofits.

orgs.outside: Its school pilot in Dang is outside Kathmandu and not counted here.
orgs.name: UN-Habitat Nepal
orgs.summary: Its staff called for early warning and preparedness in 2025; a heat activity of its own in Kathmandu was not identified in the sources reviewed.

authorities.name: Lalitpur Metropolitan City
authorities.role: Where permeable pavements were tested, in the Kathmandu Valley.

activities.title: Urban green spaces, tree planting and community forests
activities.desc: Greening work in the valley reported as underway; who leads it is not named in the source.

activities.evaluation: Results not given in the source read.
activities.title: Permeable pavement trial in Lalitpur
activities.desc: Permeable pavements tested in Lalitpur Metropolitan, next to Kathmandu.

activities.title: Survey of migrant workers in the heat

gaps: Whether Kathmandu Metropolitan City has any heat plan or seasonal measures; none was found.

start_here.text: The worker survey and the World Bank analysis are the most specific evidence on Kathmandu found.

method_note: Sources were found by web search in English; local-language sources were not searched systematically. Where a source could not be read, nothing rests on it.
